notes: hook 2: a clear stake for every cab user in one line: the regulator fined Ola a specific Rs 10 lakh over the 'quicker ride' prompts riders have seen, on a full-frame Ola mark; the number itself is not surprising, the stake carries it. read 2: cover to what Ola suggested and what its own data showed, to the deadline, Ola's argument and the Rapido precedent, to where to complain; every line earns the next, each fact once. send 2: the surprising finding (add-on requests were accepted less often, per Ola's own data) gives a specific forward to the friend or parent who taps the add-on at airports and stations. keep 2: National Consumer Helpline 1915 and 1800-11-4000, app and portal, plus the 15-day compliance deadline. reply 2: 'Have you ever added a tip or add-on just to get a cab to accept your booking?' is genuine and from riders' own lives; exactly one question. original 2: idly's own reading of a 55-page order with every figure double-sourced (disputed percentages and the Rs 140 left out), own design, Commons photo credited with licence and 'cropped'. alone 2: every slide names Ola or the helpline and reads without the caption.
